meta.name: iron-proxy-gateway
meta.description: Use Iron Proxy for external accounts and APIs, including GitHub through gh. Connect credentials through the operator console and diagnose blocked requests without exposing tokens or adding unnecessary MCP servers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让外部账号和接口调用都走代理,排查被拦截的请求,不用暴露密钥
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 想让程序安全访问 GitHub 等外部账号,又不想把令牌暴露出去
copy.tagline_en: Route API calls through a proxy, trace blocked requests, keep tokens hidden
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your programs need external accounts like GitHub without exposing tokens

howto.what: 它让 Claude 的外发 HTTP/HTTPS 请求都走 Iron Proxy：要连外部账号时执行 ncl groups connect 并返回 connect_url 给你，凭据与授权由运维控制台配置、需人工批准，Claude 手里只有占位符而非真实 token。
howto.when: 当你需要访问外部 API 或账号（包括用 gh 访问 GitHub）、请求被 403 拦下，或要诊断被拦截的请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 ncl groups connect 连接 api.github.com
say.note: 返回 connect_url，需运维在控制台配置凭据与授权

say.text: 我的请求被 403 拦了，请报告主机名和错误让运维检查
say.note: 不会绕过代理或放宽 TLS 校验

howto.what_en: Claude sends HTTP/HTTPS requests through Iron Proxy. To connect an external account it runs ncl groups connect and returns the connect_url; credentials and approval come from the operator console, and Claude holds only a placeholder, never a real token.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need an external API or account (including GitHub via gh), when a request is blocked with 403, or when diagnosing a blocked request.

say_en.text: Connect api.github.com for me with ncl groups connect
say_en.note: Returns a connect_url the operator must configure

say_en.text: Use gh against my GitHub repos with gateway-managed as the token
My request got a 403 — report the hostname and error for an operator check
say_en.note: It won't bypass the proxy or weaken TLS
